fullDescription: A high-contrast, modern dark-mode integration showcase featuring a dual-direction infinite scroll carousel. The style is defined by a bold 'Neon Green' (#4ADE80) on black palette, heavy brutalist typography (Archivo), and soft radial spotlight effects. It utilizes edge-masked containers for a seamless 'fade-out' scrolling effect. Ideal for SaaS, fintech, music-tech, or creative agency landing pages that need to highlight partnerships or platform connections.
prompt:
## Resumo
A dark-themed integration section featuring bold uppercase headings, a spotlight background glow, and two rows of icons scrolling in opposite directions behind a horizontal gradient mask.

## Estilo Visual
Create a UI style based on a black (#000000) and neon green (#4ADE80) color scheme. Use 'Archivo' as the primary font with weights 400, 500, 800, and 900. Headers must be uppercase with tight tracking (-0.03em) and leading (0.9). Icons should be housed in 'waveform-cards': 64x64px boxes with #141414 background, 1px border of rgba(255,255,255,0.08), and 14px border-radius. Implement a background 'spotlight-glow' using a radial-gradient(circle 600px at 50% 200px, rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.12), transparent). All scrolling elements must use a mask-image linear-gradient (to right, transparent, black 15%, black 85%, transparent) to fade the edges. CTA buttons should be pill-shaped, bg-[#4ADE80], text-black, font-weight 800, with a hover shadow of [0_12px_32px_-12px_rgba(74,222,128,0.6)].

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header Section
Center-aligned header with an eyebrow label in #4ADE80, 12px, 800 weight, 0.16em tracking, uppercase. Below it, a large 36px-60px (mobile-to-desktop) heading in white, 900 weight, uppercase, tracking-[-0.03em], line-height-0.9. Add 64px margin below this section.

### Infinite Carousel
A 90vw width container with overflow hidden and a 15% side-fade mask. Inside, two rows of icons. Row 1: animate-scroll-left (0% to -50% translateX) at 28s linear infinite. Row 2: animate-scroll-right (-50% to 0% translateX) at 28s linear infinite. Each row contains duplicated sets of 64px cards with 24px (1.5rem) gaps. The layout must use 'w-max' for the scrolling inner container to ensure content doesn't wrap.

### Footer CTA Area
Positioned 64px below the carousel. A centered text block with max-width 440px. Body text in #8A8A85, 16px, 1.6 line-height. Below the text, a primary button: 56px height, rounded-full, #4ADE80 background, black text, 800 weight, 14px size, uppercase, 32px-40px horizontal padding. Include a slight -2px Y-axis lift on hover.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Waveform Infinite Row — A dual-direction scrolling component with edge transparency.
Container: 90vw, overflow: hidden, mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 15%, black 85%, transparent). Inner: flex, w-max, gap: 24px. Animation: 28s linear infinite. First row translates 0 to -50%, second row translates -50% to 0. Icons are wrapped in 64px square dark-gray cards with subtle borders.

### Neon Spotlight Button — A high-impact pill button with a localized glow effect on hover.
Pill-shaped (rounded-full), bg-[#4ADE80], text-[#000000], font-weight: 800, text-transform: uppercase, letter-spacing: 0.05em. Transition: all 0.3s ease. Hover state: transform: translateY(-2px), box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -12px rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.6).

## Notas Especiais
MUST use 'w-max' on animated containers to prevent icon wrapping. MUST ensure exactly 50% translateX in animations for seamless loops. MUST use the specific edge mask to avoid harsh cut-offs of the carousel. DO NOT use generic rounded corners; stick to the specific 14px radius for cards to maintain the 'squircle' aesthetic. DO NOT use standard weights for Archivo; it must be 800 or 900 for the 'heavy' look.
